<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % intEnt "<!ENTITY extEnt 'internal expanded'>">
  %intEnt;
  <!ENTITY ref "&extEnt; with recursion-like structure">
  <?target-pi processing instruction value?>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binaryData SYSTEM "file.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining the test case structure -->
  <sub:child sub:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &references;, and other entities: &ref;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ref;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | note)*> <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ge "General Entity Reference">
  <?xml-meta version="2.0" status="draft"?>
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docFile SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<document xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment block containing DTD test notes
       - verify parsing of parameter entities
       - check namespace collision handling
  -->
  <section id="s1" xlink:type="simple">
    First section content with entity ≥
    <note>
      <![CDATA[
        Nested CDATA with markup inside a note element: <note>≥</note>
      ]]>
    </note>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "&entA; and Value B">
  <!ENTITY entC "&entB; and Value C">
  <?catalog-action execute="refresh"?>
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment: Testing deep entity chaining combined with CDATA and namespaces -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload with entity reference: &entC; inside CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item xi:include="fallback.xml">&entC;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Item One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; - Item Two">
  <!ENTITY e3 "&e2; - Item Three">
  <?inventory-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
  <!NOTATION json SYSTEM "application/json">
  <!ENTITY conf SYSTEM "config.json" NDATA json>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.example.com/ns" xmlns:v="http://inventory.example.com/version">
  <!-- Comment: verifying parser behavior on deeply nested entity expansions -->
  <v:stock code="XYZ-999">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed block with nested structure: <stock>&e3;</stock>
    ]]>
  </v:stock>
  <stock>&e3;</stock>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <?system-audit user="admin" timestamp="2025-01-01"?>
  <!NOTATION xml SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY schema SYSTEM "schema.xsd" NDATA xml>
]>
<system xmlns="http://sys.example.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://sys.example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment: checking multiple rare constructs (DOCTYPE, ENTITY, PI, CDATA, xmlns) simultaneously -->
  <meta:node id="node-1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing entity reference: γ and some <xml> tags.
    ]]>
  </meta:node>
  <node>γ</node>
</system>
